title: AnalyticsChatMetrics

distinct_artifacts_created_count.title: Distinct Artifacts Created Count
distinct_artifacts_created_count.description: Number of distinct artifacts created. Exact in date-range mode: a creation belongs to exactly one day, so the per-day counts never overlap and their sum over the window is the exact count of distinct creations in it.

distinct_connectors_used_count.title: Distinct Connectors Used Count
distinct_connectors_used_count.description: Distinct claude.ai connectors this user used. Excludes calls whose connector could not be identified and all calls from organizations with zero data retention. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_conversation_count.title: Distinct Conversation Count
distinct_conversation_count.description: Number of distinct conversations the user participated in. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_files_uploaded_count.title: Distinct Files Uploaded Count
distinct_files_uploaded_count.description: Number of distinct files uploaded. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_projects_created_count.title: Distinct Projects Created Count
distinct_projects_created_count.description: Number of distinct projects created. Exact in date-range mode: a creation belongs to exactly one day, so the per-day counts never overlap and their sum over the window is the exact count of distinct creations in it.

distinct_projects_used_count.title: Distinct Projects Used Count
distinct_projects_used_count.description: Number of distinct projects used. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_shared_artifacts_viewed_count.title: Distinct Shared Artifacts Viewed Count
distinct_shared_artifacts_viewed_count.description: Number of distinct shared artifacts the user viewed. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_skills_used_count.title: Distinct Skills Used Count
distinct_skills_used_count.description: Number of distinct skills used. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

shared_conversations_viewed_count.title: Shared Conversations Viewed Count
shared_conversations_viewed_count.description: Number of times the user opened a shared conversation in a project

thinking_message_count.title: Thinking Message Count
thinking_message_count.description: Number of messages that used extended thinking

description: Claude.ai activity metrics for a single user on a given day.
